THE IDEA

A product, its maker and its evidence in one place.

Good design deserves more context than a photograph and a price. We want people to understand the maker behind an item and the limits of the available evidence.

01 / MAKER

Who made it?

We will check the maker’s public identity, website and trading history, then show the sources used.

02 / PRODUCT

What is being offered?

Listings will explain the materials, specifications, origin story and delivery context supplied for each product.

03 / PROOF

What can be supported?

Documents, audit badges and certificate claims will be labelled by check status, with links and a date checked.

THE PLANNED JOURNEY

Verify. List. Buy. Review.

We are preparing each stage before the first product goes live.

  1. 01 / VERIFY

    Check the maker

    Gather public sources, review documents and have a person approve the report.

  2. 02 / LIST

    Publish the product

    Show its story, specifications, FI Score and linked evidence once the record is approved.

  3. 03 / BUY

    Choose with context

    Ordering will open after product terms, availability and payment details are confirmed.

  4. 04 / REVIEW

    Learn from buyers

    Customer reviews can add a later signal. No review score exists yet.

What “not found” means.
Some evidence may not be publicly available. We will label a missing source “not found” rather than treating it as a failed check. Reports will show evidence coverage alongside a provisional FI Score.
